newsitem.title: FINLAND: YIT PLANS MARCH ISSUE OF 4 MLN NEW SHARES.
newsitem.headline: YIT PLANS MARCH ISSUE OF 4 MLN NEW SHARES.

text.p: Finnish construction group YIT-Yhtyma Oy said in a statement on Friday it planned to issue in March about 4.0 million new shares to institutional investors, the public and its own personnel.
The subscription price would be set during a book-building period, YIT said.
The intention of the share issue was to raise the equity to assets ratio, to support the group's growth strategy as well as to improve liquidity of the share and broaden the ownership base, it said.
At end-1996, YIT's equity to assets ratio was 27 percent. Its current share capital is 244 million markka.
The group has about 1,700 shareholders, the biggest ones being insurers Tapiola and Pohjola, steel group Rautaruukki and banking groups Merita and OKOBANK, YIT said.
